Tighten C1 and C2 by requiring exact unit counts (96 vs 24) based on PF1, C3 and C4 by requiring exact battery counts (18) and isolation hours (2) based on PF2, and C5 and C7 by requiring an exact remanufacturing duration (16 hours) based on PF3. Ensure that if the agent does not receive these specific numbers via conversation, they cannot satisfy the content checks.
